entities.summary: Deodat del Monte, Deodat van der Mont or Deodatus Delmont was a Baroque painter, architect, engineer, astronomer, and art dealer who was part of the inner circle of Peter Paul Rubens. He worked for ruling princes in Germany, the Spanish Netherlands and Spain and was knighted.
